title: Native bat bridge lacks per-run environment forwarding
body: tools/vixen-native.sh run_bat forwards a fixed WSLENV list, so an unchanged lane batch could not receive VIXEN_HUD_OFFSCREEN_CAPTURE; I had to bypass the wrapper with a queued, quoted powershell.exe call to invoke the batch. Suggested consolidation: add a declared environment-forwarding option to the native bat bridge while retaining queue admission. Tier haiku, effort S.

title: Native VIXEN build lacks stale executable lock preflight
body: The queued hudkit1 Release build reached the final copy and failed with Error copying file ... VIXEN.exe because a stale native VIXEN.exe process held the destination; the build did not identify the owner. I validated the exact Windows PID and terminated it, then the retry passed. Suggested consolidation: native build preparation should detect/report stale output owners or provide a safe preflight cleanup. Tier haiku, effort S.
